设计意图： This mutation preserves the parent’s lower-tail fragility mechanism: it measures the share of recent realized variance attributable to losses. A short causal exponential smoothing layer is added to reduce transient day-to-day shifts in the bounded concentration estimate, targeting more stable cross-sectional ordering and lower signal churn without introducing another economic feature family.

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. ts_ema —— 指数移动平均
    ts_ema(divide(ts_mean(power(clip(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), , ), 2), 20), ts_mean(power(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 2), 20)), 5)
  2. 2. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(ts_mean(power(clip(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), , ), 2), 20), ts_mean(power(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 2), 20))
  3. 3. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(power(clip(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), , ), 2), 20)
  4. 4. power —— 取幂(乘方)
    power(clip(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), , ), 2)
  5. 5. clip —— 裁剪到区间[下限,上限]
    clip(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), , )
  6. 6. ts_pct —— 过去 N 天变化率
    ts_pct(AdjClose, 1)
  7. 7. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(power(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 2), 20)
  8. 8. power —— 取幂(乘方)
    power(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 2)
  9. 9. ts_pct —— 过去 N 天变化率
    ts_pct(AdjClose, 1)

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
power计算 x 的 y 次方
ts_eman 期指数移动平均（EWMA）
ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 1) ret = (close - ts_delay(close,1)) / ts_delay(close,1) 当日收益
  2. 2) neg_returns = min(ret, 0) 仅取亏损部分
  3. 3) down_var = ts_mean(20, neg_returns^2) 20 日下行方差
  4. 4) total_var = ts_mean(20, ret^2) 20 日总方差
  5. 5) down_ratio = down_var / total_var 下行方差占比
  6. 6) smoothed = ema(span=5, down_ratio) EMA 平滑
  7. 7) factor = cs_rank(smoothed) 截面分位排名
来源：手写步骤（factor_manual_61 / formula_lqtp 人工核对）

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_downside_semivariance_smoothed(df): """Smoothed trailing concentration of ">class="kw">return variance ">class="kw">in downside outcomes.""" df_copy = df.copy() ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change() downside_sq = ret.clip(upper=0.0).pow(2).rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean() total_sq = ret.pow(2).rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean() concentration = downside_sq / total_sq.replace(0.0, np.nan) df_copy["factor_downside_semivariance_smoothed"] = concentration.ewm(span=5, adjust="kw">class="kw">False, min_periods=5).mean() "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_downside_semivariance_smoothed"]
